description: This phrase gained global recognition after an article by a Rutgers University journalist was published in the United States. Dior's first collection helped revitalize the French fashion industry following World War II. Europe was still suffering the consequences of the war at the time, but the New Look helped bring back opulence to the streets of Paris in the 1950s and restabilished it as an international centre of fashion. [ 2 ] Haute-Couture had declined during the war.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Hyperfeminity, opulence, sensuality
